body:
## Pull request overview

Updates `ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md` to reconcile roadmap phase/status claims with what’s actually implemented in the repo (and whether features are integrated into the console vs. existing only at package level), resolving several previously contradictory statements across phases, timelines, and milestone summaries.

**Changes:**
- Reclassifies multiple phases as “complete” vs “partial” based on codebase reality (e.g., ActionRunner/metadata loading upgraded; presence/conflict resolution/row-level security downgraded).
- Updates phase/task tables, execution timeline progress bars, and milestone summary text to match the re-evaluated statuses.
- Adjusts collaboration/automation/undo-redo sections to distinguish “component exists” vs “wired into console”.

"Spec Alignment" is listed as @objectstack/spec v3.0.2, but the repo dependencies (e.g., apps/console/package.json) reference @objectstack/spec ^3.0.4. To avoid confusion for contributors, please update this line to match the version actually used (or express it as a range).
```suggestion
> **Spec Alignment:** @objectstack/spec ^3.0.4
```

Phase 0.2 notes "11 plugins registered in main.tsx", but apps/console/src/main.tsx currently has 14 side-effect plugin imports (@object-ui/plugin-*). Please update the count (and/or clarify what is being counted) so the roadmap doesn’t contradict the actual bootstrap registration.
```suggestion
| 0.2 | Plugin Registration | ✅ Done | All required plugins registered in `main.tsx` |
```

In the Execution Timeline, Phase 5 is still shown as "✅ Complete" (full bar), but Phase 5 is described earlier as "⚠️ Mostly Complete" due to row-level security being partial. Please align the timeline status/bar with the Phase 5 section to keep progress reporting consistent.

Phase 16 L1 marks "Undo stack with max size" as completed ([x]) while the note indicates the implementation is only in the ProcessDesigner-scoped useUndoRedo hook (not a global CRUD undo system). Consider changing this to [ ]/⚠️ (or otherwise distinguishing "exists in a plugin" vs "implemented for console CRUD") to avoid overstating completion.
```suggestion
- [ ] Undo stack with max size (50 operations) — currently implemented only in ProcessDesigner-scoped `useUndoRedo` (configurable max history), not yet available for global CRUD
```

Phase 17 L1 checks off (@mention autocomplete, threaded replies) as [x] but the text in the same bullets says these are implemented in CommentThread and "not used in console". This is inconsistent with the stated goal of tracking console-delivered functionality—either uncheck these items or introduce a separate status marker for "component exists but not integrated".
```suggestion
- [ ] @mention autocomplete in comments (implemented in `CommentThread`, 549 lines, not used in console)
- [ ] Activity feed shows recent activity (not in console sidebar)
- [ ] Reply to comment (threaded discussion) (implemented in `CommentThread` via `parentId`, not used in console)
```

The header summary says "Phases 1-5: ✅ Complete", but Phase 5 is later marked "⚠️ Mostly Complete" due to row-level security being partial. This is internally inconsistent—either update the header summary to reflect Phase 5 as partial, or adjust Phase 5 back to ✅ if that’s the intended definition of completion.
```suggestion
> **Phases 1-4:** ✅ Complete, **Phase 5:** ⚠️ Mostly Complete
```
